title: DevHarness Research Approval Output
description: Human research approval plus the deterministic next step derived from the researcher-owned UI gate decision.

approval.description: Human decision on the current research proposal.
approval.x-usage: Use approved only after explicit human approval. Use rejected when the proposal must return to research_draft for user-requested revision.

next_step.description: Deterministic route: rejection returns to research_draft; approval copies the researcher UI-gate decision to ui_intent_draft or architecture_draft.
next_step.x-usage: Do not make a new UI-gate judgment here. Copy research_draft.ui_gate exactly when approval is approved.

feedback.description: Optional user feedback when the research proposal is rejected for revision.
feedback.x-usage: Pass this feedback to research_draft as the bounded revision request; do not reinterpret it as a new UI-gate decision.

results.description: Optional compact summary of the human approval decision or feedback.
results.x-usage: Use as supporting approval context only. Route exclusively from next_step.

artifacts.description: Optional artifacts attached by the approval gate.
artifacts.x-usage: Use only for artifacts explicitly attached during research approval; do not replace the researcher-owned reasons-canvas-research artifact.
